description:
FILED s528 (Fable, 2026-10-25) at the first red CI run of MAIN-READY-48 (s527a merged): both workflows failed their dependency step because upstream PPI master has `use YAML::PP ();` in PPI/Document.pm (dist.ini [AutoPrereqs] lists it; 1.291 did not need it).  Every local check passed because this box has YAML::PP v0.39 in perlbrew's site_perl from the CPAN board; a stock runner has none.  FIX-FORWARD on main (s528, Fable): libyaml-pp-perl added to .github/workflows/ci.yml and tools/install-matrix/deps.sh, YAML::PP to tools/install-pcl's remedy text, README.md (two lines), CLAUDE.md Dependencies + the CI-machine sentence, Pl/t/core-deps-01.t's header note.

TWO HALVES, both for the PPI/vendoring owner (s527b or a filler):
(1) On the `pcl` branch: PPI::Document loads YAML::PP ONLY inside the PPI_CUSTOM_FEATURE_INCLUDES branch (`require YAML::PP` there; the `use YAML::PP ()` at the top goes), with a test that PPI loads with YAML::PP hidden from /home/bernt/perl5/perlbrew/perls/perl-5.40.3/lib/site_perl/5.40.3/x86_64-linux /home/bernt/perl5/perlbrew/perls/perl-5.40.3/lib/site_perl/5.40.3 /home/bernt/perl5/perlbrew/perls/perl-5.40.3/lib/5.40.3/x86_64-linux /home/bernt/perl5/perlbrew/perls/perl-5.40.3/lib/5.40.3 (`-M-YAML::PP`-style: a `t/` row that forks a perl with an /home/bernt/perl5/perlbrew/perls/perl-5.40.3/lib/site_perl/5.40.3/x86_64-linux /home/bernt/perl5/perlbrew/perls/perl-5.40.3/lib/site_perl/5.40.3 /home/bernt/perl5/perlbrew/perls/perl-5.40.3/lib/5.40.3/x86_64-linux /home/bernt/perl5/perlbrew/perls/perl-5.40.3/lib/5.40.3 hook refusing YAML/PP.pm and requires PPI) -- PPI's two-commit shape, suite green; dist.ini [AutoPrereqs] then needs `skip = YAML::PP` or a `[Prereqs / Recommends]` entry, say which in the PR text.  Then YAML::PP leaves PCL's lists again (same six places).
(2) ONE SOURCE for the dependency list: a data table in tools/lib/PCLVendor.pm (or beside the UPSTREAM stamp) that tools/install-pcl's check reads, that Pl/t/core-deps-01.t compares against the vendored lib's non-core closure (computed the way the guard already computes its closure, PPI's namespace excluded, Class::XSAccessor / PPI::XS / Time::HiRes excluded as upstream's own optional set), and that a tools/t row checks ci.yml + deps.sh + README name the same modules (apt names via a fixed map: Clone -> libclone-perl ...).  The guard would have turned the s528 red run into a failing gate row.  Bar: the gate; `prove tools/t/install-pcl.t`; `prove tools/t/install-container.t` (podman is on this box) for the recipe.
subject: The vendored PPI pulls YAML::PP at LOAD time (upstream master PPI::Document:74 `use YAML::PP ()`, used only when PPI_CUSTOM_FEATURE_INCLUDES is set) -- make the load LAZY on the pcl branch (an upstreamable two-commit PR), then drop YAML::PP from PCL's dependency lists; and make the dependency list ONE SOURCE (installer remedy, ci.yml, deps.sh, README, CLAUDE.md all spell it by hand) with Pl/t/core-deps-01.t asserting the vendored lib's non-core closure EQUALS that list
